raw_segments.text: And surely, the miser individually will be an ignoble competitor in a state for any prize
of victory or other object of honorable ambition.
He will not spend his money in the contest for glory.
So afraid is he of awakening his expensive appetites and inviting them to help and join
In true oligarchical fashion, he fights with a small part only of his resources, and the
result commonly is that he loses the prize and saves his money.
